name: 字母绣拼色毛边牛仔短裙款

category.leaf: 字母刺绣拼色下摆牛仔短裙

description: 单排扣门襟、撞色字母刺绣、假两件拼色毛边下摆的浅蓝牛仔短裙

styleLock.backgroundSystem: 奶油色圆角卡片底与深炭黑面料质感分段交替，白色页边距包边
styleLock.lightingSystem: 明亮柔和扩散棚光，前左主光，柔和自然投影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 哑光奶油背景纸与浅灰水泥地面（场景）
styleLock.typography: 粗衬线大标题（中文以「」包裹）+ 细无衬线小标签
styleLock.iconSystem: 细线描边圆圈图标，墨黑 #1A1A1A 线条
styleLock.presentationRules: 模特上身展示为常态，裙装居中稳定，产品占比逐镜声明
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womenswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm cream background #F5F1E8, ink black banners and text #1A1A1A, warm sand secondary panels #E4D9C8, and muted gold star accent #C9A24B; warm tone; bold serif display headlines wrapped in 「」 paired with thin sans-serif micro labels; alternating cream rounded-card backdrops and deep charcoal fabric-texture sections; bright soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key and soft natural shadows; thin-line icons inside thin-stroke circles; clean commercial fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏以墨黑横幅+雾金星饰+模特上身建立经典复刻基调，抢住第一眼。
shots.camera: 平视中景，模特胸部至胯部取景，轻微 3/4 侧身
shots.lighting: 明亮柔和扩散棚光，前左主光，柔和自然投影
shots.background: 奶油色圆角卡片背景 #F5F1E8，白色页边距
shots.textZone: 顶部墨黑横幅白字标题位，两侧雾金星饰
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce opening hero poster of {product} worn by a female model cropped from chest to hips, eye-level medium shot at a slight 3/4 angle with the garment as the clear focal point. {product_identity_lock}. Bright soft diffused studio lighting, front-left key, soft natural shadow grounding the model. Warm cream rounded-corner backdrop card #F5F1E8 inside a clean page frame. Product occupies 50-55% of frame; an ink-black banner #1A1A1A runs across the top with a white serif headline reading 「{callout_1}」 flanked by small muted gold star accents #C9A24B, and the model fills the lower frame so no area is left empty. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand wordmark, no real logo, no watermark, no recognizable celebrity face, no extra text, no clutter, no cut-off edges.

shots.textZone: 顶部胶囊描边标签位、中央大标题位、2×2 卡片内短标签位
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce benefit infographic of {product}: top pill-shaped outline tag reading 「{callout_2}」, centered bold serif headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」, and a 2x2 grid of thin-line icon cards on warm sand panels #E4D9C8, each card with a thin-stroke circle icon and a short label 「{callout_3}」. Straight-on flat composition, symmetric grid alignment. {product_identity_lock}. Bright even flat lighting for readability, cream page background #F5F1E8. The garment photo is featured large inside the top-left card and repeated as a slim strip along the bottom card, overall garment occupancy 50-60%, with natural page margins around the card grid. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no dense body text, no fake certification icons, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no misaligned grid.

provenance.notes: 13 片 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。页面文字多为通用填充套词（多处提及连衣裙/针织衫/立领等，与图中实际商品牛仔半身裙不符），分类以图片实际内容为准：女装/裙装。已剥离：页首英文 wordmark、裙身刺绣原文字（改用 {callout_8} 槽位呈现）、货号、试穿者昵称、页尾二维码会员贴纸与模特身份。与库内「高腰排扣毛边牛仔半身裙」同源结构，本款以字母刺绣+拼色假两件下摆作更具体款式定位区分。
